item.title: COMAC's 10-Ton Electric Aircraft Completes First Crewed Flight
item.description:
COMAC's 10-ton electric commercial aircraft CE-25A completed its first crewed intelligent flight in Binzhou, Shandong, carrying two pilots and one flight-test engineer with all systems nominal. Following its uncrewed first flight in February 2026, the milestone shifts validation toward pilot-in-the-loop human-machine collaboration closer to real commercial operations. The aircraft uses distributed electric ducted fans across the wings and 500 Wh/kg condensed-matter batteries, seats 19 with a 400 km range, and has had its type certificate application accepted by the CAAC.

原文标题：中国商飞 10 吨级电动飞机完成有人驾驶首飞

Why it matters：国产电动商用飞机从无人验证迈入有人驾驶在环阶段，是低空经济与航空电动化的重要工程节点。

item.title: Baijing Air's W5000 Cargo Drone Completes Maiden Test Flight
item.description:
Baijing Air's W5000 large unmanned cargo aircraft completed a technical validation flight in Ordos, Inner Mongolia, claiming the title of the world's largest payload cargo drone with 5 tonnes of capacity and a 2,600 km range. It cuts tonne-kilometre costs by over 40% versus comparable crewed freighters, lets one crew supervise 6-7 aircraft, and uses a fully domestic supply chain.

原文标题：白鲸航线 W5000 完成试飞 载重 5 吨航程 2600 公里

Why it matters：全球最大业载无人货运飞机完成关键试飞，是大型物流无人机从总装下线走向适航验证的重要节点。

item.title: Nvidia Allegedly Funded AI Startups to Absorb GPU Oversupply
item.description:
The Wall Street Journal reports that Nvidia invested in AI startups that then purchased its GPUs and built data centers, allegedly to sustain the perception of high demand and absorb excess semiconductor supply from TSMC. The report also notes that CFO and acting CEO Colette Kress pushed to scale back such circular financing arrangements after Jensen Huang's resignation. If substantiated, the allegation would directly undermine market assumptions about genuine AI compute demand.

原文标题：英伟达被指投资 AI 初创以消化 GPU 库存

Why it matters：该报道涉及算力供需真实性与厂商资本运作，对判断 AI 基础设施景气度具有实质影响。

item.title: Multi-Agent Orchestration Needs Main Session Plus Drill-Down Subtasks
item.description:
Baoyu critiques current AI coding agent session designs: single-main-session tools like Grokbot and Dots hide subtask execution details, while Claude Code's many-session model burdens users with tracking each session. He argues the ideal is a hybrid where users watch only the main conversation, an orchestrator routes messages and dispatches tasks, and users can drill into any task to intervene directly.

原文标题：多智能体协作需主会话与子任务双层结合

Why it matters：对智能体会话与任务编排交互范式提出有洞察力的产品设计思辨，对 Agent 工具开发者有参考价值。

item.title: Apple Details Privacy Protections for HomeView Smart Home Hub
item.description:
Apple executives Matthew Costello and Cecilia Dantas detailed the privacy design of HomeView, the company's first smart home hub, in an interview with TechRadar. The device recognizes up to six family members without manual account switching and hides private content as soon as another person enters the camera view or the paired iPhone leaves the network.

The move is seen as the first real signal of a Huang comeback and sets out what major investors consider minimum acceptable governance standards.

item.title: GlobalFoundries Breaks Ground on New York Fab with $10 Billion Investment
item.description:
GlobalFoundries has broken ground on the first of two US-Japan cooperative fabs at its Malta, New York site, backed by roughly $10 billion in initial investment and slated to start production in 2029 with about 75,000 300mm wafers per month. Under the Japan-funded, GlobalFoundries-operated model, the two-fab project could total $21 billion, marking a concrete milestone in US-Japan semiconductor supply chain cooperation.

原文标题：格罗方德纽约新晶圆厂动工 投资 100 亿美元

Why it matters：美日联合出资的先进晶圆厂动工，是算力基础设施与全球半导体供应链格局的实质进展。

item.title: ggml Ships v1.0.0 as Dependency-Free Tensor Library
item.description:
ggml has released v1.0.0, marking the first formal versioned milestone for the tensor library underpinning the llama.cpp ecosystem. Its core value is a dependency-free C/C++ implementation spanning x86, ARM, RISC-V and more, with 2- to 8-bit integer quantization plus MXFP4 and NVFP4 microscaling formats and zero runtime memory allocation. For local-inference and edge-deployment developers, this signals long-term ecosystem stability.

原文标题：ggml 发布 v1.0.0 无依赖张量库正式定版

Why it matters：支撑 llama.cpp 与本地推理生态的底层张量库首次发布正式 1.0 版本，具有生态里程碑意义。

item.title: Natura Launches Interface Ring to Summon AI Agents With a Thumb Press
item.description:
Natura unveiled Interface, a smart ring that turns a thumb press into a voice request routed by NatureOS to existing agents such as Claude, ChatGPT, Grok Bot, Meta's Muse or Instinct, letting users assign different models to different tasks. Responses return via headphones or the iPhone lock screen without unlocking the phone or opening an app. Natura claims it surpassed Oura's first-generation 2,383 orders in 30 days within 72 hours.

原文标题：Natura 推出智能戒指 Interface 一键唤起多个 AI 智能体

Why it matters：可穿戴硬件作为多智能体统一入口的尝试，展示了跨模型路由与免解锁交互的产品形态。

item.title: Eli Lilly CEO Pushes Back on AI Cancer Cure Timeline
item.description:
Eli Lilly CEO Dave Ricks publicly rebutted Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's prediction that AI will cure cancer within a decade, calling the vision appealing but unlikely. He argued that major gaps remain in biological understanding and that randomized human trials, not drug discovery speed, are the real bottleneck, so AI will likely deliver steady incremental progress rather than a sudden breakthrough.

原文标题：礼来 CEO 回应 AI 十年攻克癌症论调

Why it matters：两大产业领袖就 AI 在药物研发中的真实边界公开交锋，为 AI for Science 的落地节奏提供了来自制药一线的冷静判断。

item.title: Anthropic Breaks Down Five Building Blocks of Always-On Agents
item.description:
Anthropic published 'Building always-on agents' by William Hu, breaking down the five core components of persistent AI agents: event-driven inbox wake-up, timer-based proactive triggers, persistent memory folders, account permission constraints, and outbox output control. The piece covers concurrent event conflict handling, memory frugality, human approval for sensitive actions, and why agents should start out quiet.

item.title: SBF's $500M Anthropic Bet Would Be Worth $37B at IPO
item.description:
FT reports that Sam Bankman-Fried's Alameda Research Ventures bought nearly 14% of Anthropic in 2021 for $500M at a roughly $4B valuation; at next week's expected IPO price that stake would be worth about $37B. After FTX's collapse, the bankruptcy estate sold the stake in 2024 for about $1.3B. The same fund also took about 5% of Cursor maker Anysphere for $200K in 2022 and sold it for the same amount in 2023; at the $60B SpaceX paid for Anysphere, that stake would be worth about $3B.

原文标题：SBF 当年 5 亿美元投资 Anthropic 如今价值约 370 亿美元

Why it matters：以 Anthropic 预期 IPO 定价为锚，量化 FTX 破产财产过早出售股份的机会成本，是观察 AI 资产估值膨胀的典型样本。

The project now supports over 150 model architecture variants and mainstream speculative decoding methods, backed by expanded self-hosted CI runners across NVIDIA, AMD, Qualcomm, Arm, IBM and Intel hardware.

item.title: Subquadratic Releases SubQ Snap 1.2 Decision Model, Ties for Top Spot
item.description:
Subquadratic released SubQ Snap 1.2, which scores 73 on the Artificial Analysis Decision Index v2.1, up 5 points from v1.1 and tied with Drex Max v1.1 and GLiDE v1.2 for the lead. Gains stem mainly from a higher all-pass document rate (46% to 62%) and improved non-hallucination via abstention, while raw accuracy stays flat. Pricing remains $0.04 per 1M input tokens with a 384K context window.

原文标题：SubQ Snap 1.2 决策模型发布 追平榜首

Why it matters：决策模型榜单出现并列榜首，且提升来源被拆解为拒答而非准确率，对关注模型评测口径的读者有参考价值。

item.title: Fed Flags AI as Top Financial Risk for Wall Street
item.description:
The Fed's financial stability report shows 87% of polled market professionals now name AI as the top financial risk, up from 50% in spring. AI infrastructure debt surpassed $680B by October, roughly 5x all of 2023 and about 31% of investment-grade corporate borrowing, while big tech and chipmakers carry over $3T in future leases and guarantees that may understate true AI exposure. GPU makers guarantee chip values and invest in the same buyers, creating circular financing, and the largest US banks hold close to $1T of exposure to big tech and data center builders.

原文标题：美联储警示 AI 成华尔街头号金融风险

Why it matters：美联储官方报告首次将 AI 列为头号金融风险，并给出债务规模与循环融资的量化证据，是判断 AI 资本周期风险的关键信号。

item.title: China's MIIT Moves to Form Industrial OS Standards Working Group
item.description:
China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) is accelerating the formation of a standards working group for industrial operating systems, alongside drafting and validating key standards to support large-scale adoption. Industrial OS is positioned as a critical foundation for AI-enabled industry, shifting from single-project pilots toward reusable common platforms plus industry-specific capabilities. A companion AI-plus-software initiative targets 20,000 large software firms by 2028, while IDC forecasts China's industrial enterprise AI spending to reach RMB 280 billion by 2030.

原文标题：工信部筹建工业操作系统标准工作组

Why it matters：工信部推动工业操作系统标准化，直接关系 AI 赋能工业的底座与生态走向，对关注产业落地的读者有明确参考价值。

item.title: 流程工业智能工厂新国标发布 2027 年 5 月实施
item.description:
市场监管总局（国家标准委）批准发布《智能制造 流程工业智能工厂业务管理规范》（GB/T 48536—2026），自 2027 年 5 月 1 日起实施。该标准首次提出流程工业智能工厂业务管理框架，涵盖研发设计、生产制造、运营支撑、全链协同和管理方法五大模块，并要求以工业大数据为核心建立全流程统一数据平台，推动数字孪生与人工智能辅助调度优化和异常工况处置。标准已在石油化工、冶金、制药等行业代表性企业试点验证。

Why it matters：国家级智能工厂标准落地，为流程工业的 AI 与数据平台建设提供统一合规标尺，直接影响石化、冶金、制药企业的数字化路线选择。
